description: Canonical local cognition portfolio for z0intelligence#20. Role assignments come from locally reproduced measurements only; source_reported_benchmarks is recorded for evidence and is NEVER read by selection.

rtx3080ti-12gb.note: system_ram_gib is what the current sandbox namespace reports; the bare-metal value may differ.

role_notes.semantic_orchestrator: DEMOTED FROM nemotron_orchestrator_8b ON MEASURED EVIDENCE. On the 12-scenario multi-turn orchestration benchmark qwen3.5_4b and qwen3.5_9b each solve 9/12 while Nemotron solves 6/12, and the 4B is 2.4x faster (p50 4740 ms vs 11475 ms). Nemotron is also dominated on bounded choice (17-20/28 vs 24-26/28) and its licence is non-commercial. It remains a research candidate only; see docs/local-cognition-portfolio.md.
role_notes.tiny_action_specialist: hammer2.1_3b, not the declared experiment target functiongemma_270m: measured 24/28 at p50 185 ms against FunctionGemma's 14/28 zero-shot. FunctionGemma keeps this role as a FINE-TUNING target (z0intelligence#20 phase 10) and must beat the Pareto frontier before it is promoted.
role_notes.bounded_scorer: Canonically declared in the decision_roster of manifests/models.z0int.json. Never abstained on 25/28 fixtures, so the cascade re-checks its confidence before accepting its answer; without that the rest of the ladder is dead code.
role_notes.general_local_fallback: qwen3.5_9b: 28/28 schema validity and 26/28 correct with an adequate completion budget. Its latency means it is a backstop, not a hot path.
role_notes.remote_specialist_fallback: Deliberately unset: remote seats resolve from the dynamically inventoried FREE provider paths, never from a static list here.

nemotron_orchestrator_8b.mechanism: ToolOrchestra RL (GRPO) on Qwen3-8B with outcome-, efficiency- and user-preference-aware rewards. Alternates reasoning and tool calling over multiple turns, dispatching to basic tools, specialist LLMs and generalist LLMs while trading accuracy against cost/latency. Trained on 552 synthetic problems / 1296 prompts.
nemotron_orchestrator_8b.notes: Local GGUF evidence: general.architecture=qwen3, qwen3.context_length=40960, file_type=15 (Q4_K_M), chat template carries a tools block.

functiongemma_270m.mechanism: Gemma 3 270M architecture with a function-calling chat format, trained on 6T tokens of public tool definitions and tool-use interactions.
functiongemma_270m.notes: Card provenance: the upstream card is gated (raw fetch 401), so the claims above were read from the identical official card mirrored at unsloth/functiongemma-270m-it plus Google docs; revision and license tag come from the HF API. Local GGUF evidence: general.architecture=gemma3, gemma3.context_length=32768, sliding_window=512, head_count_kv=1, file_type=7 (Q8_0), general.license=gemma.

agent0.name: Agent0
agent0.license: Apache-2.0 (repository code); no serving checkpoint released under this id
agent0.mechanism: Zero-external-data self-evolution: co-trains a Curriculum Agent and an Executor Agent from the same base LLM. External tools strengthen the executor, which pressures the curriculum agent to generate harder tool-aware tasks.
agent0.notes: Belongs in Evolution Lab as a training arm; never a serving checkpoint and never online self-modification in production. Reported gains are for Qwen3-8B-Base (+18.3% math AVG, +22.0% general AVG per README; the paper abstract's '24%' does not match the README table - recorded as a discrepancy).
